paragraphs.text: Samiks was one of the Marked Ones in the Ice Age of Dominaria .

The Balduvian warrior was dying of the plague, but he still went to deliver a message to Kailo and Zaraya about Lim-Dûl poisoning the waters of his homeland. When he couldn't walk any further, he waited for them to arrive while hanging on a tree in full armor. It was Samiks who gave Zaraya the Nova Pentacle and died afterwards.
